marc:datafield.marc:subfield: LAIN daRI yaNg LAIN. EPISOD 4. SIRI 8.

Contains 3 segments: SEGMENT 1 The result of a creative touch by a resident in Tumpat, Kelantan, in producing batik paintings. These paintings adorn every single wall space of their house. For those who have never seen this batik house, this showcase will reveal this artistic spark to you. SEGMENT 2 This week's showcase will take us to an area that offers a unique twist in cooking. Exotic cooking done by the residents of Padang Lembu, Gurun, Kedah, offers a peculiar recipe that is highly favored by certain communities, especially the Siamese community in Kedah. SEGMENT 3 In this viewer's video segment, we look at a person's innovative drive in producing soap made from papaya fruit. This soap is said to have its own unique benefits for bodily use, particularly for clearing up skin diseases.
